lines.text: Before more guests start pouring in, Ade and I slip away and head back to the base.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Yo, Pal. You did good out there.
... What's all this?
Spread out on the table in the base
are all manner of tools and devices.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: This is the equipment that Boss kindly provided to me when I was assigned this mission.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Hmm... You may think of them as a... tactical loadout of sorts.
Cocoa would love this.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Hehe, I was actually planning to show this to her later.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Dang, there's all sorts of stuff here,

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: but this is what we're gonna use.
Milk points at a transparent glass box.
Inside lays a strangely shaped mechanical device.
What's this?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: It's a kind of 3D printer.
A printer? What does it print?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Masks.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: They're designed to blend almost perfectly with the skin, leaving no visible trace to the naked eye.

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: All right then, since Noob's here too, shall we get started?

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: First, I'll scan Noob's face.
Exia lifts her phone and scans my face from top to bottom.

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: Now, with this data... it'll create a mask that fits your face perfectly.

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: There are a few presets

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: but I'll go with the most handsome one, just for you.
The device begins to move and crafts a mask inside the glass case.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: To be honest, I haven't completely mastered how to use these devices yet.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: If Miss Exia hadn't been here, we would have been in serious trouble.

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Oh, Coach, I found this in the storage as well.
Bay hands me a suit, an overcoat, and a fedora.

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: This'll do the trick as a disguise. It'd make your build look a bit different too.
Great. That way, I won't have to keep running away.

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: ... Well, that's true.

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Still, I'm not sure this is going to work.

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: The guests... all seem really worked up.

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Some of them are just charging at any young guy they think might be Coach.
She points at a monitor.
The camera feed shows a small scuffle that's occurring in the Main Hall.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Well... guess we gotta just wing it and scrape through, or bust our asses running again.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Right, Pal?

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: Don't jinx it...
... Let me get changed first.
I change into the outfit first, then put on the finished mask.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Er... how should I put this...?

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: You look like some business magnate's spoiled rich kid.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: ... Yes, that's what I was gonna say.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Still, you look completely different on the surface.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: That should be enough to avoid most suspicion.
... I suppose so.
I look into the mirror Bay hands me
and see the face of a guy who, just like Exia said, looks like he's got a real nasty attitude.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Honestly, with a face like that, I doubt anyone's gonna want to come talk to you.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Anyway, there's nothing left to wait for, right? Let's go.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Didn't you two make some stupid rule about going all out in a cat and mouse game?

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Then I'll catch her right away and beat her to a pulp.
... All right, let's go.
I get up and open the door to the base...
*Bang!*
... then quickly shut it again.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: What's the matter? Did you see a ghost or something?
Th-that's not it.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: What the heck is wrong with you?
Milk opens the storage unit door herself.
*Click*
Without a word, she closes it again.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: ... We're in deep trouble.

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: This is the CCTV footage from the corridor outside the storeroom unit.
In the footage Exia pulled up on the monitor, a few guests are walking down the corridor.
No, they're not just wandering around, but rather, they're clearly looking for someone.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: No way, they're already sniffing around this far in?

lines.speaker: rouge_b
lines.text: After Highroller disappeared from sight,

lines.speaker: rouge_b
lines.text: it seems they changed tactics—from chasing aimlessly to splitting up and conducting a methodical search.

lines.speaker: rouge_b
lines.text: ... Exia, can you hear what's going on outside right now?

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: Afraid not. There aren't any audio devices in this corridor.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Allow me to try this.
Ade pulls out a long cable.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Is that one of the gadgets Boss gave you?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Yes. If I slide it through this narrow gap...
Ade slides one end of the cable through the bottom gap of the door.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: we should be able to pick up their voices.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Miss Exia, would you be so kind as to connect this to the computer?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: And might I trouble you to do the same for the video feed as well?

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: On it.
Soon, voices start coming through the CCTV feed.

lines.speaker: cautiousfemaleguest
lines.text: Hey, this area's off-limits to unauthorized personnel.

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: Don't worry, as long as we don't get caught, we're good.

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: Besides, you gotta think outside the box to succeed, right?

lines.speaker: cautiousfemaleguest
lines.text: Anyone can talk big, right?

lines.speaker: cautiousfemaleguest
lines.text: ... But hey,

lines.speaker: cautiousfemaleguest
lines.text: do you really think they'll pay if we catch that Commander guy?

lines.speaker: cautiousfemaleguest
lines.text: I mean, it's 100 million credits, you know.

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: After all, this event was organized by Mustang himself,

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: and he's never messed around with the prizes before.

lines.speaker: cautiousfemaleguest
lines.text: Well... I suppose that's true.

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: And honestly, even without the prize, this kind of event is just so much fun,

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: don't you think?

lines.speaker: cautiousfemaleguest
lines.text: This really isn't my thing.

lines.speaker: cautiousfemaleguest
lines.text: I wouldn't be at this event if you hadn't dragged me here.

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: Pfft. Come on,

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: how many times have I seen you pretend not to care, only to get totally obsessed?

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: Whatever. Since we're here, we might as well enjoy ourselves.

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: If we win something, that's just a nice bonus.

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: ... Oh, and you know what?

lines.speaker: cautiousfemaleguest
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: That Commander we've been chasing... he's a real cutie.

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: Think we can get his number if we manage to catch him?

lines.speaker: cautiousfemaleguest
lines.text: Are you for real?

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: Hey, you never know when fate will strike!

lines.speaker: cautiousfemaleguest
lines.text: I-I'll think it over.

lines.speaker: exia_b
lines.text: It's the same elsewhere too.
Exia displays footage of each area in Coin Rush on the monitors.

lines.speaker: rouge_b
lines.text: The level of participation has far exceeded our expectations.
I'll be okay... right?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I-I believe so...

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: What'll you do if it's not okay? You planning on staying holed up in here forever?

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: We need to get back out there and look for the thief. Am I right, or am I right?

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Still... it seems risky to head out right now.

lines.speaker: bay_b
lines.text: Let's at least wait until they're gone first.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: All right, I'm gonna go kick them out—wait, hold on.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Check that out.
Milk points to the CCTV feed showing the corridor.

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: Hey! Excuse me!

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: You there! Mister!
Two women rush toward a man who appears at the far end of the corridor.
Oh? That person...

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: Got you! This is the right person, isn't it!?

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: That 100 million credits are mine!

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: And while we're at it, I'll take your number—

lines.speaker: coinrushsecurity
lines.text: What's going on here?

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: Huh...? Wait, are you not the guy?

lines.speaker: coinrushsecurity
lines.text: No, I'm a security guard...

lines.speaker: coinrushsecurity
lines.text: No, actually, more importantly—

lines.speaker: coinrushsecurity
lines.text: Ugh, today's just not my day.

lines.speaker: coinrushsecurity
lines.text: ... Are you not aware this area is off-limits to unauthorized personnel?

lines.speaker: activefemaleguest
lines.text: Er... uh... well, the thing is...

lines.speaker: coinrushsecurity
lines.text: Please come with me.

lines.speaker: coinrushsecurity
lines.text: That means you three over there as well! Don't even think about running!
... In an instant, the security guard escorts five guests away.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: That guy's really been through a lot today...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I shall have to offer him my apologies later...
*Click*
I gingerly open the door and step into the empty corridor.
Okay, I think we're good to go.
Then I'll just—huh?
Just as I'm about to take off running, Ade and Milk stick close beside me.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Look, Pal, I'm not letting you wander alone.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Who knows what kind of crap that Velvet chick's cooking up?

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Just earlier, she was practically drooling all over you!

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Yes, I agree. I don't think you should go alone.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: At the very least, with Milk and me by your side, we should be able to subdue Velvet should we encounter her again.

lines.speaker: bay_b_op_r
lines.text: That's right, but I'm not much help when it comes to fighting.

lines.speaker: rouge_b_op
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: rouge_b_op
lines.text: Let's split up and search again, like we did at the beginning.
... All right.
